messages.subject: Nvim-R 0.9.15 released
parts:
Dear all,

I released a new version of Nvim-R with the following changes:
  • Minor bug fixes.
  • New options: R_omni_size and R_omni_tmp_file.
I have told that I would not release a new version with minor bug fixes, but I am going to merge new code in the master branch on GitHub that is not working well on Windows. So, I decided to release the code before breaking it.

Best regards,

Jakson Aquino
